source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: This model's demolisher cannon can target enemy units in **Engagement Range** of this model, as long as no other friendly unit is in Engagement Range of the targeted unit. Its ranged attacks also never take the **Hit roll** penalty for being in Engagement Range of enemy units.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

ability.proviso: no other friendly unit is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit
